answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on an attestation graph, with transition mass governed by conductance. A sybil cluster that inflates identities without many honest attestations creates a sparse external cut; low conductance limits probability flow from trusted seeds, while min-cut and transitivity bounds cap its aggregate voting weight. Even when a nebula of identities shares a trellis of collusion, each thread cannot amplify influence beyond that spectral bound.
